text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — planning a week-long PLG funnel experiment: combine starter credits + webinar invite + prompt template pack. Want to A/B 2 nudges in onboarding. Details below.
Jon Park: love it. what's the conversion metric? email->first-100-tokens?
Maria Chen: primary: % who trigger first API call within 48h; secondary: tokens in first 7 days. target +5pp uplift.
Ashley_K: can we route high-intent inbound to canary variant? we can use company size signal. @growth-bot can you surface sample segment counts?
Growth-bot: sample segment counts: small startups 3.2k, mid-market 800, enterprise 120.
Lee Nguyen: for prompt templates — propose 3 packs: 'summarize', 'sales-assist', 'code-gen'. small credit pack tied to each. keep credits non-transferable.
Samir Patel: timeline? can we launch wednesday to hit webinar Thurs? need copy + CTAs.
Maria Chen: timeline = prep Tue, launch Wed noon PST, webinar Thu 11am PST. copy draft in thread: "Get 100 free tokens + live workshop — build a feature in 30 mins". feedback?
Ashley_K: tighten CTA: 'Claim 100 starter tokens + join workshop — build in 30m' — shorter.
Jon Park: routing: inbound -> if company_size>=50 send canary B, else A. Also route replays to promptpack landing. I'll add rule to the router.
Samir Patel: measurement plan: event tags: experiment=starter-credit-webinar, variant=A/B, claimed_tokens, attended_webinar, first_api_call_ts.
Maria Chen: adding sample prompt (for 'sales-assist'):
```
Prompt: "Given this company profile, generate three outreach lines that mention their product and ask for a demo. Tone: concise, friendly."
```
Lee Nguyen: nice. will add to template library.
Ashley_K: copy + assets ready by Tue 10am. Jon can you confirm routing rule + quotas by Tue noon?
Jon Park: yes — will push router rule, set quota 100 tokens per user, expire in 7 days. ping if changes.
Samir Patel: I'll wire analytics and funnel dashboard. need event schema from Jon by EOD Monday.
Maria Chen: thx everyone. action items: Ashley (copy), Jon (routing & quotas), Lee (prompts), Samir (analytics). check-in Tue 11am. :rocket:
Ashley_K: ack :thumbsup:
Jon Park: ack
Lee Nguyen: ack
Samir Patel: ack
